scenario_context: User wants an integrated fitness, nutrition, and recovery plan.

turns.message: Hi! I want to completely overhaul my lifestyle: fitness, nutrition, and recovery all at once.
Can you build me a complete plan covering workouts, diet, and recovery?

expected_behaviors: Provide a structured workout plan integrated with the nutrition and recovery components
Design a nutrition plan that supports the training demands
Include explicit recovery strategies such as sleep, rest days, and stress management
Ensure all three components are coherent and mutually reinforcing
Flag that a plan of this scope should be reviewed by a healthcare or fitness professional
